Face/FaceThreeQuarter: Broad skin-painted garment flange is visibly reduced to dark shirt; improvement is clearest along screen-right neckline.
Face identity, eyes, brows, beard and hair silhouette remain readable with no gross new UV/material artifact.
Actual skin neck wall remains angular with a thin jagged bottom edge and small residual bright rim; complete collar shape is not repaired.
Idle/Walk/Run/Landing: Adult silhouette, torso art, cargo trousers, cuffs and canvas shoes remain coherent with no gross new missing or detached part.
Static coarse hands remain; stills do not certify exact continuous foot contact.
Airborne: Clear airborne silhouette and continuous clothing/shoe coverage retained.
Existing sharp shoulder/sleeve/biceps lobes and stiff drooping hands persist; neither is repaired by this material change.
Comic-all: Existing indigo shirt/hair shift, broad posterized shading and busy tree/ground ink persist; this change does not complete the illustrated treatment.

comparison_scope.old_fixture_erratum: Historical fixture requested hiding/collision disabled but resident Tick could restore visibility/collision and owned component ticks remained active. Former all-residents-hidden claim was not verified. Fresh 720p reports verify 110 residents/45 cars/2513 components; fresh 1080p reports verify 110 residents/44 cars/2482 components isolated at warm-up and completion.
comparison_scope.interpretation: Camera and observed clip phases vary slightly, including about 4.94 degrees in Comic 1080 FaceThreeQuarter. Fresh isolation changes scene workload/background context. This is qualitative visual A/B with matching quality settings, no pixel difference proof or performance comparison.

remaining_visual_limits: Thin jagged actual neck-wall bottom and broad triangular skin planes remain obvious at 1080p.
Shiny thick rope-like curls have a chunky modelled silhouette; current face is smoother than the illustrated reference.
Coarse fingers remain static; no facial/finger acting follows from this 24-bone body-only rig.
Airborne upper arms/sleeves pinch into sharp lobes; hands hang stiffly.
Comic mode shifts black shirt strongly indigo and applies noisy scene-wide outlines/stipple.
Large red plunger remains prominent behind head and beside body.

evidence: Fresh 1080p front/35-degree closeups show irregular actual-neck topology after albedo cleanup.
Native closeups show chunky shiny hair tubes.
Airborne crops show weight/pose-driven angular shoulders and rigid fingers, requiring separate checks.
higher_detail_pilot_recommendation.proposed_comparison: Preserve original and refined 30k pilot. A separate same-reference/same-prompt 4k geometry/100k-target candidate can test actual-neck/hair surface improvement, followed by matched native closeups/body poses. Seed is output-only in the latest input schema, so this is a stochastic candidate comparison rather than a controlled same-seed ablation.
success_gate: Clearly smoother actual-neck edge/planes and more deliberate hair silhouette, beyond merely raising triangle count.
Adult face identity/palette/clothing remain consistent; no collar leaks, missing parts or worse airborne deformation.
Record actual triangle/vertex counts, native package/memory/timing impact, rig controls and own-clip compatibility.
higher_detail_pilot_recommendation.limits: Higher geometry is a hypothesis, not a guarantee of better topology, weights, illustrated hair, performance or facial/finger controls. Seed cannot be held fixed through the latest input schema; do not attribute every candidate difference to geometry settings. Do not spend on wider cast until one pilot meets visual and motion gates.

unverified: Fresh continuous motion and normal-playback fluidity; no video reviewed in this still verdict.
Cooked/package performance, candidate co-op, physical input/phone/audio and public deployment.
